title: Part-Time Content Editor (The Human Layer in an AI Workflow)
description:
Affilino is an SEO agency working with a portfolio of AU/NZ clients across e-commerce, legal, and other verticals. We draft a lot of content with AI, and we run automated humaniser scripts that strip the obvious AI tells (em dashes, 'in today's landscape,' rule of three, sycophancy, hedging, all that). So by the time content reaches you, it already reads cleanly on the surface.



That's the easy 80%. We're hiring you for the 20% no script can do.



What we actually need from you:



1. Judgment on truth. AI will write 'industry observers have noted' or 'a 2024 study found.' We need you to ask: is that real? Find the source or kill the claim.



2. Lived voice. AI writes like someone who has read about a topic. We need it to sound like someone who has done it. Anecdote, specificity, the small detail that proves the writer was actually in the room.



3. Editorial taste. Knowing what to cut. Knowing when a paragraph is technically fine but adds nothing. Knowing when the intro is buried in the third paragraph.



4. Brand voice memory. We run content for several clients, each with a different tone. A legal client is sober. An e-commerce client is warmer. You'll learn each voice and hold the line.



5. Catching second-pass AI residue. After a humanizer pass, what remains? Often: confident-sounding sentences that don't actually say anything. Generalities dressed as insight. You will hunt these.



What you will NOT do:



- Run our content through ChatGPT or another humanizer and send it back. We already have that.

- Surface-level proofreading. Grammarly handles that.

- Generic 'make it more engaging' rewrites.



Who you are:



- Native-level written English

- 2+ years editing experience (publication, agency, in-house, or strong freelance portfolio)

- You read a lot. Books, longform journalism, Substacks. You have opinions about writing.

- You can tell us, in plain words, what makes a sentence dead

- You meet deadlines

- Comfortable in Google Docs



Bonus:

- SEO awareness (H-structure, internal links, search intent)

- Background reading or editing in legal, e-commerce, insurance, or finance

- You've worked with AI content workflows before and have war stories



How to apply:



Skip the cover letter. Send us:



1. One paragraph on a piece of AI-generated content that fooled you or your client recently. What was the giveaway when you looked closer? If you've never been fooled, tell us what you watch for.



2. 1-2 work samples (before/after if possible).



3. Your monthly rate in USD.



4. Include the word 'mango' in your reply.



Shortlisted candidates get a paid 500-word test edit on real content. The piece will have already been through an automated humanizer pass, so the test is whether you can find what the machine missed.



Looking forward to reading your work.

You will engage on behalf of our clients inside comments, replies, and DMs to build relationships, create familiarity, and naturally guide conversations toward a next step when appropriate.

– Ask thoughtful follow-up questions to keep conversations moving

– Recognize when to transition a conversation toward connection or booking

– Maintain professionalism, warmth, and clarity in all written communication



Story & Light Content Support

– Assist with Instagram Stories (text, polls, replies, short clips)

– Repurpose approved content across platforms when needed



Tracking & Admin

– Track daily engagement activity (comments, DMs, conversations started)

– Monitor response quality and engagement patterns

– Assist with light content scrubbing for short video clips



Required Skills & Traits

– Excellent written English (grammar, tone, vocabulary, clarity are non-negotiable)

– Strong conversational instincts and emotional intelligence

– Familiarity with Instagram and LinkedIn (comments, DMs, Stories, basic analytics)

– Ability to sound human and brand-aligned, never scripted or robotic

– Organized, self-directed, and comfortable with feedback



Working Hours:

This role has set engagement windows:

– 4:00am–7:00am PST

– 3:00pm–6:00pm PST

– Monday through Thursday minimum

Occasional brief admin tasks may occur outside these windows.



To Apply:

Step 1: Loom Video (Required)

Please record a 5–7 minute Loom answering the prompts below. We’re looking for how you think, speak, and write, not perfection.

1. Instagram Experience

How do you personally use Instagram day to day, and what features do you use most (comments, DMs, Stories, etc.)?

2. Starting Conversations

If you were networking on behalf of a client, how would you leave comments that feel natural and start real conversations?

3. Guiding Toward a Next Step

How would you naturally move a conversation from casual engagement to a potential call or appointment without sounding salesy?

4. Tone & Voice

How do you adjust your language when speaking on behalf of someone else’s brand?



Step 2: Written Questions (After Loom Review)

If your Loom is a fit, we’ll ask you to answer the questions below:

Q1: On a scale of 1–10, how confident are you using Instagram’s tools (comments, DMs, Stories, analytics)? Why?

Q2: Share an example of an online interaction that turned into a real relationship, opportunity, or next step.

Q3: How do you d
 when to keep a conversation casual versus when to guide it toward a next step?

Q4: How do you ensure your written English stays clear, professional, and aligned with someone else’s voice?

Q5: Are you open to a short paid test project (1 hour or less) to demonstrate engagement and comment strategy?



Step 3: Test Project

Selected candidates will receive a short paid engagement exercise using real examples so we can evaluate comment quality, DM tone, conversation flow, and judgment.

title: Inbound Sales Appointment Setter (Remote, Full-Time, Pacific Time)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

ABOUT US



We are a family-owned hair salon based in Southern California that has been operating for over 20 years. Our specialty is color and highlight services, and our clients are primarily women aged 35 to 65 who come back to us for years.



Over the past year, we've built out a Meta ads funnel using GoHighLevel as our CRM and phone system, and we're now generating a steady flow of inbound leads from
 and Instagram. I'm hiring one full-time appointment setter to handle all of those leads and book them into the salon.



This is a long-term role. I'm looking for someone who wants to stay with us for at least a year and grow into the position.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



You will be the only person responsible for converting our inbound leads into booked appointments.



- Work inbound leads from our Meta ads through call, SMS, and DM 
 and Instagram) inside GoHighLevel

- Run our booking script as written: discovery questions, offer presentation, and the card-on-file close

- Handle objections using the framework I will train you on (reframe value, build trust, induce gentle urgency without being pushy)

- Send Stripe payment links to capture the card on file, then book the appointment in our calendar

- Charge the card on file in Stripe for any late cancels or no-shows (a few minutes per day)

- Log every interaction cleanly in the CRM so I can review conversion data and refine the script over time



The most important 
nt on every call is getting the card on file. Once we have it, our show rate jumps from around 55% to 90%, so that is the part of the script that matters most.





KPI TARGETS



This is a high-volume, metrics-driven role. You will know exactly how you are performing every day.



- Calls per day: 150 to 250

- Leads worked per day: 17 to 25

- Lead-to-booking rate: 25% or higher

- Show rate: 90% or higher (after card on file)

- Bookings per day: 4 to 9

- Showed appointments per month: 100 to 160





WHAT WE NEED YOU TO KNOW BEFORE APPLYING



Script adherence is a dealbreaker. We need you to follow the script word for word on the key parts of every call. We use conversion data to test what's working and what isn't, and if everyone is freestyling their own version, the data is useless. If you have ideas to improve the script, we genuinely want to hear them, but you raise them with as feedback, not by changing things on calls.



The schedule is fixed. Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM US Pacific Time. For someone in the Philippines, that is 11:45 PM to 8:45 AM PHT (an overnight shift). No exceptions, no shift swaps, no occasional late starts. We need someone who has actually worked overnight shifts before and knows they can sustain it for at least 12 months.



Tech reliability is non-negotiable. The role does not work if your internet drops two or three times a week. I will ask about your backup plan (mobile hotspot or second ISP), and we will test your connection and audio live from your actual work setup before any offer.





REQUIREMENTS



- 6 to 12 months of phone-based sales, appointment setting, or BPO experience (4+ hours per day on the phone)

- Clear, neutral English with strong listening skills (you'll be talking to US-based women aged 35 to 65 all day)

- Comfortable with high call volume (150 to 250 dials per day) and a long-term commitment to that pace

- Strong script discipline and comfort operating inside a defined process

- Reliable home office setup: 8GB RAM minimum (16GB preferred), wired headset with boom mic, computer mouse, internet at 25 to 50 Mbps down and 10 to 20 Mbps up, ping under 50ms, and a real backup internet plan you have actually used

- Available Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM US Pacific Time (overnight in the Philippines)



NICE TO HAVE



- Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (CRM and phone)

- Experience with Stripe payment links

- Background in B2C inbound sales (beauty, wellness, fitness, medspa, or salon)

- Personal interest in beauty, hair, or self-care



COMPENSATION



- Base: $900 USD per month

- Performance bonuses: $3 per new client show, $2 per existing client show, $1 per rebooking show

- Monthly threshold bonuses (cumulative): +$75 at 90 shows, +$150 at 120 shows, +$350 at 150 shows

- On-target earnings: approximately $1,300 to $1,815 per month

- PTO: 14 days per year after a 90-day probation period

- Payment: Paid through 
 on a regular schedule

- Equipment: I will buy you a headset if you need one. Computer and internet are yours.



To be straightforward about the structure: roughly 30 to 50% of your monthly income will come from performance bonuses. If you want a high guaranteed base with low expectations, this isn't the right fit. If you want a clear path to earn more by actually performing, the math works well here.





HOW TO APPLY



Submit a link to your updated resume, and Please send me a cover letter explaining:



1. Your most relevant phone-based sales or appointment setting experience (how long, what industry, what volume)

2. Your history with overnight shifts and how long you sustained that schedule

3. Your home internet speeds (down/up) and your backup plan

4. Whether you can commit to the Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM PST schedule for at least 12 months

title: Behind-the-Scenes Cinematic TikTok Editor for Trading Card Brand (Long-Term)
description:
WE NEED THE EDITOR WHO MAKES OUR WAREHOUSE LOOK LIKE A DOCUMENTARY



I am hiring a part-time TikTok editor for a fast-growing Trading Card Game (TCG) content brand. This post is for editors who specialize in cinematic, documentary-style behind-the-scenes content.



Behind-the-scenes content builds trust because viewers see the real operation. We want editors who can take raw warehouse footage, inventory shots, packing sessions, and lifestyle 
nts, then turn them into cinematic 30-60 second pieces with strong visual storytelling. Think slower pacing, atmospheric music, layered B-roll, mood-driven edits.



WHAT YOU WILL EDIT



- 5-8 BTS / documentary videos per day, Monday to Friday

- 30-60 second cinematic edits with B-roll, voiceover (if provided), atmospheric music

- Topics: warehouse tours, inventory shots, pack-opening sessions, day-in-the-life of running a TCG business, customer fulfillment scenes

- Strong cinematic pacing: slower cuts, mood setting, visual storytelling over verbal narration

- Color grading and exposure correction where needed

- Output 9:16 vertical, deliver via Drive



STYLE REFERENCE



Study cinematic short-form creators: travel filmmakers on TikTok, fashion BTS content, restaurant kitchen documentaries. Look for editors who think in mood and atmosphere, not just trends. 
 
 for our brand reference, but cinematic style will be more polished. These are reference accounts only, not the brand you will be editing for.



REQUIREMENTS



- 12+ months short-form video editing experience (higher bar for cinematic work)

- Portfolio with cinematic, documentary, travel, or fashion content

- Color grading proficiency (CapCut LUTs, Premiere Pro Lumetri, DaVinci Resolve color page)

- Comfortable with B-roll-heavy edits (visual storytelling without dialogue)

- Music selection and pacing skills

- Available Mon-Fri, 5 days/week, around 1.5 to 2 hours/day

- Filipino editors preferred for timezone alignment



BONUS POINTS



- Background in film school, photography, or travel content

- Adobe After Effects for motion graphics and titles

- Comfortable with cinematic LUTs and grading workflows

- Personal Instagram or portfolio site with cinematic content



COMPENSATION



PHP 16,800/month (paid weekly at PHP 4,200 every Friday). 5-8 cinematic videos/day x 5 days = 25-40 videos/week. Lower daily volume justified by craft-intensive editing. Performance bonuses after 60 days.



HOW TO APPLY



In your application include:

1. 2-3 portfolio links showing your best cinematic or BTS editing work

2. Your usual turnaround time for one 30-60 second cinematic edit

3. Confirm you can commit to 5-8 cinematic videos/day, Mon-Fri

4. Pick any past cinematic edit and describe the mood you were trying to create (2-3 sentences)



Applications missing the mood description will not be reviewed.



SELECTION PROCESS



1. Review application within 48 hours

2. Short message exchange with shortlisted candidates

3. Final hire within 1 week

4. First week serves as paid trial. Meeting standards = continue. If not = part ways professionally, keep trial payment



Long-term role, minimum 3-month commitment expected.

description:
Job Title: Purchase Order Administrator (Remote – Philippines Based, Day Shift)



About Us

Life Interiors is a leading Australian modern furniture retailer with showrooms in Sydney, Melbourne, and Brisbane, supported by a thriving e-commerce store. With 17 years in the industry, we are passionate about great design, detail, and seamless operations.



We are expanding our global team and looking for a highly organised Purchase Order Administrator based in the Philippines. This role ensures smooth order processing, supplier communications, and accurate purchase order management within our ERP system (NetSuite).



What’s In It for You?

*100% work-from-home (remote flexibility).

*Day shift schedule – aligned with Australian business hours.

*Competitive salary package based on experience.

*13th month performance-based bonus

*HMO/health coverage after probation.

*Annual leave + sick leave.

*Long-term career stability with a growing, design-led company.

*Supportive and collaborative international team environment.



Job Overview

You will play a key role in the administration, coordination, and communication of purchase orders. You’ll ensure all details are accurate, timelines are met, and records are properly maintained across our ERP system (NetSuite).

You’ll be the link between our suppliers, internal teams, and freight partners — keeping everything organised and on track.



Key Responsibilities

*Accurately raise, upload, and manage purchase orders in NetSuite.

*Confirm product details, quantities, costs, and ETDs with suppliers.

*Track order progress and proactively follow up to avoid delays.

*Liaise with the Product and Management teams regarding any discrepancies in fabrication, cost, or delivery.

*Communicate with Freight Forwarders to ensure bookings and documentation are submitted on time.

*Work with the Supply Chain and Warehouse teams to resolve inventory discrepancies.

*Check and confirm carton layouts prior to shipping.

*Provide regular updates on inbound container schedules.

*Support the creation of new product entries in the system.

*Continuously seek ways to improve processes and workflows.



About You

*2+ years’ experience in administration, purchasing support, or stock/order management.

We are looking for someone who understands how to identify opportunities in a market, uncover customer insights, develop winning concepts, execute those concepts into high-performing ads, analyze performance data, and continuously improve creatives through structured feedback loops.



You will be responsible for the entire creative process:



Research ? Strategy ? Concept Development ? Editing ? Testing ? Iteration

Market Research

 groups, comments, support tickets, competitor ads, and other research sources

* Identify customer pain points, frustrations, objections, desires, and buying motivations

* Continuously discover new creative opportunities



Creative Strategy



* Develop new angles, concepts, hooks, and messaging frameworks

* Edit short-for
ta and TikTok ads

* Source footage and supporting assets

* Leverage AI tools when appropriate to improve execution



Creative Analysis & Feedback Loops



* Review creative performance regularly

* Analyze winners and losers

* Identify why creatives succeeded or failed

* Build improved iterations based on real-world results

* Continuously refine concepts and messaging based on performance data



We are not interested in:



* "Let's test it and see what happens"

* Random creative ideas with no supporting research

* Repeating the same concept with slightly different hooks

* Surface-level competitor research



Every concept should have a clear rationale backed by customer insights, market research, or previous performance data.

What Success Looks Like

* Creative quality and performance improve over time

* The creative system becomes more intelligent with every test

Important



We are looking for someone who thinks like an owner, not an employee.



Someone who takes responsibility for the creative outcome, continuously learns from performance data, and is obsessed with understanding customers and creating better advertising.

title: Looking for a Scriptwriter & Researcher — Geo-Exploration YouTube Channel (Faceless)
description:
Hey!



I run a faceless YouTube channel built around exploring the world through satellite imagery, historical maps, and geographic research — without ever leaving a desk. Every video investigates one specific place: somewhere real, somewhere strange, somewhere that raises a question most people have never thought to ask.



I'm looking for a scriptwriter and researcher who can bring these places to life — and keep an audience hooked from start to finish. Here are some examples of the type of content we create









---



**The tone**



Think of an enthusiastic teacher who just found something genuinely weird on a map at midnight and cannot wait to show you. Not a documentary narrator. Not a YouTube host doing an intro. 



First-person. Conversational. Plain English — if a 14-year-old can't follow it, rewrite it. Enthusiastic but never over the top. The discovery is the story. The facts are what you find along the way.



No generic openings. No "Hey guys, today we're looking at...". No "Buckle up!" No BBC documentary voice.



---



**Retention is everything**



My viewers currently drop off around the 5–6 minute mark. That needs to change.



I need a writer who can structure tension across an entire 8–12 minute video — not just nail the first 30 seconds. That means:



— A hook that starts in the middle of something, not at the beginning of an explanation

— A new surprise, twist, or "wait — really?" moment every 90–120 seconds throughout the video

— A mid-video re-hook around the 3–4 minute mark that gives people a reason to keep watching

— A payoff at the end that makes the viewer feel like staying was worth it



Good storytelling structure. Not tricks.



---



**Requirements**



— Scripts of at least 1,800 words per video

— Delivery within 5–7 days per script (with room to discuss pace as we scale)

— Each script includes both the written narration AND a full research/visual package (see below)

— Fluent English — natural and conversational, not formal or journalistic

— Genuine interest in maps, geography, exploration, or history

— Available for ongoing collaboration — this is not a one-off hire



---



**What you deliver with every script**



**1. The script**

First-person, plain English, structured for retention. Editor cues embedded throughout — every scene should tell the editor exactly what to show and which layer to use.



**2. Visual research package**

A curated list of images, maps, satellite stills, and archival material. Public domain or Creative Commons only. Every item listed with source URL and licence type. The editor opens this list and immediately knows what to use.



**3. Map and layer notes**

Which historical map overlays are relevant. Where to find them. Which imagery dates to use. Which data layers to activate. Specific, not vague.



**4. Source list**

Every factual claim verified and cited. Wikipedia is fine as a starting point — primary sources preferred where available. No fabrication. No unverified theories presented as fact.



---



**What I do NOT want**



— Generic openings of any kind

— Complex vocabulary or academic tone

— Narration that describes what the viewer can already see on screen

— Padding — every sentence must earn its place

— Listicle structure

— Speculation presented as confirmed fact

— AI-generated content without real research and editorial judgment behind it



---



**To apply**



Don't send a cover letter about your general experience. Don't send a Google Drive folder full of scripts from other channels.



Instead, send me **one Google Drive link** with a single document inside: a sample script written specifically for this format.



Pick any real-world location that fits what's described above — somewhere verifiable, genuinely strange, worth investigating. Write the opening and first act only — roughly 400–500 words. It must:



— Open in the middle of something, not with context or setup

— Be written in first-person discovery voice

— Include at least two editor cues (what's on screen, which layer is active)

— Reference at least one historical map or archival source with a real URL

— Sound nothing like a documentary



The Drive link should contain **only this one document**. Not a portfolio. Not previous work for other channels. One document, written for this brief. If I have to search for it, I'll move on.



**Questions I'll ask every applicant:**



— Have you written for a YouTube channel in the same niche before? If yes, share the link.

— Do you have experience sourcing historical maps and archival visual material?

— What's your realistic turnaround time for a full script + research package?



Make sure all samples are shared as Google Drive links — no attachments.



---



**Budget**



$25 per completed script and research package.

title: Roll The Media iOS App Remote | Project-based
description:
About the Project

Roll The Media is a marketing and content creation company. We are building a native iOS app that combines Cinematic Mode video recording, a built-in teleprompter, and auto-captions. We have a complete spec document, UI mockups, and full feature breakdown ready — you just need to build it.



The Most Important Requirement

You MUST have experience with AVFoundation Cinematic APIs on iOS 17+. This is non-negotiable. If you have not worked with Cinematic Mode recording in a native iOS app do not apply. This is our #1 feature and the entire reason this app exists.



What You Will Build (3 features)



Cinematic Mode Recording — native AVCaptureSession with Apple's Cinematic framework, depth data preserved on export, graceful fallback on unsupported devices

Roll The Script — built-in teleprompter overlay on live camera, scrolling script text during recording, adjustable speed and font size, pause by tapping screen

Auto-Captions — import video from Photos library, on-device transcription using SFSpeechRecognizer, 4 caption styles, export as .MP4 with captions burned in



No AI editing. No avatars. No extras. Just these 3 features built extremely well.



Tech Stack

Swift 5.9+ only. No React Native. No Flutter. SwiftUI + UIKit, AVFoundation + Cinematic framework, SFSpeechRecognizer, RevenueCat for $7/month subscription.



To Apply — Answer All 5 Questions



Describe your experience with AVFoundation Cinematic APIs on iOS 17. What app? What was the result?

Paste links to 2+ iOS apps you have shipped on the App Store

What is your rate in USD or your fixed project quote?

What is your estimated timeline for V1.0?

Confirm you will build in Swift — not React Native or Flutter



Generic applications will not be answered. Answer all 5 questions or don't apply.

title: Virtual Assistant – Logistics Coordinator / Cx Support
description:
Position Overview



We are looking for a Virtual Assistant to support our logistics team. In addition, the role will support customer service operations in a fully remote role. You will be the backbone of our order fulfillment, logistics coordination, and customer support processes. This role bridges the gap between our inbound shipments from the factory to the warehouse. Then from the warehouse out to customers in order fulfillment requiring a sharp eye for detail, proactive problem-solving, and exceptional communication skills. As the business is based in Toronto, Canada, there will be 2 shifts. 8am to 12pm and 8pm to 12pm, total 8 hours per day, 5 days a week, Monday to Friday, Toronto, Canada time.



Key Responsibilities



Logistics & Order Management

• You must have experience with various Incoterms and arranging freight for bulk cargo shipments.

• Monitor orders daily via Shopify and fulfillment systems; ensure orders are processed and routed to fulfillment partners without delay.

• Track shipments in real-time, monitor delivery status, and proactively identify and flag delayed or at-risk orders.

• Coordinate with fulfillment partners (3PL, ShipHero) to resolve fulfillment issues, expedite orders, and ensure SLAs are met.

• Manage reverse logistics for returns, exchanges, and damaged shipments; coordinate return shipments and refunds.

• Manage inbound shipments from factories to 3PL warehouses in Canada and USA.



Customer Service Support

• Support lead Customer Service Agent and support as need to get through all customer messages in timely manner.

• Respond to customer inquiries regarding order status, shipping, returns, and product questions within 24 hours.

• Resolve order issues including lost packages, damaged items, sizing concerns, and delivery exceptions with empathy and efficiency.

• Process refunds, store credits, and exchanges; maintain accurate documentation of all transactions.

• Identify and escalate repeat customer issues and service gaps to management for continuous improvement.



Documentation & Reporting

• Maintain detailed and organized logs of all orders, shipments, returns, and customer interactions in Shopify and support systems.

• Generate weekly logistics reports, customer service metrics, and operational summaries for management review.

• Create and update SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) for logistics and customer service processes.



Qualifications

• 2+ years of experience in e-commerce customer service, logistics, order management, or fulfillment operations.

• Proficiency with Shopify platform and order management systems (mandatory).

• Strong experience with fulfillment and shipping platforms (ShipHero, Shippo, or similar tools).

• Excellent written communication skills (English): clear, professional, and solution oriented.

• Exceptional organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail and accuracy.

• Comfortable navigating multiple systems simultaneously (CRM tools,
 inboxes, spreadsheets, order dashboards).

• Proactive problem-solver who can identify issues, troubleshoot independently, and escalate appropriately.

• Customer-first mindset: empathetic, patient, and committed to exceptional service.

• Reliable self-starter comfortable working fully remote with minimal supervision.



Nice to Have

• Experience with apparel, fashion, intimate apparel, or beauty e-commerce brands.

• Familiarity with wholesale operations or B2B order management.

• Experience with third-party logistics providers (3PL) or warehouse management systems.

• Strong Google Sheets skills for data analysis and reporting.

title: Social Media Manager (Good Graphic Design AND video editing skills)
description:
Social Media Manager — Job Description

Remote | Part-Time ? Full-Time Potential

About the Role

Yes, I work in real estate — but the bigger picture here is that I'm building a personal brand. This role isn't about pushing property listings. It's about building me as a recognisable figure in my space, growing a loyal audience, and turning that audience into a community that buys into me, not just the business.

I'm looking for a sharp, dependable Social Media Manager to take ownership of my content output. You'll produce 15 pieces of content per week. I provide the raw content — ideas, footage, voice notes, scripts, captions — and you turn it into polished, scroll-stopping posts that build the brand.

This is not a passive role. I want someone proactive, who asks questions, pushes back when they see a better way, and treats my brand like their own.

Weekly Workflow

This is the rhythm. It is non-negotiable.

• Sunday — I present the content deck to you (raw material, ideas, footage, direction for the week ahead).

• Monday to Friday — You present completed content to me daily for review and feedback.

• Saturday morning — All 15 pieces of content must be fully finalised, including every revision I've requested, and scheduled to go live from Sunday onwards.

• Sunday — Content begins publishing. The cycle restarts with the next deck.

If you can't hit this schedule consistently, this role isn't for you.

What You'll Be Doing

• Produce 15 pieces of content per week (Reels, carousels, static posts, stories) using the raw material I provide.

• Design high-quality graphics — carousels, quote cards, covers, branded templates.

• Edit short-form video to a professional standard — cuts, captions, transitions, hooks, retention edits.

• Schedule and publish content across platforms in line with the agreed posting plan.

• Write or refine captions and hooks where needed.

• Track performance, flag what's working, and suggest tweaks based on data.

• Stay on top of trends, audio, and formats so we're never late to a wave.

• Bring ideas to the table — not just execute mine.

What I'm Looking For

• Proven experience building personal brands (not just business pages or product accounts).

• Strong graphic design skills — show me a portfolio. I need clean, modern, on-brand work.

• Strong video editing skills — short-form first. Capcut, Premiere, or whatever you fly with, just be excellent at it.

• A solid understanding of Instagram, TikTok, and what makes content actually convert.

• Excellent written English — captions, hooks, and on-screen text.

• Proactive mindset — you ask the right questions, push for clarity, and don't sit on tasks waiting for hand-holding.

• Highly organised. You meet deadlines without me chasing you.

• Reliable communication. I need you reachable and responsive during agreed hours.

Availability & Communication

• Daily check-ins required at a set time (we'll agree this together based on your time zone).

• Must be reachable during agreed working hours for quick turnarounds and revisions.

• I don't need constant updates — I need consistent presence and dependable delivery.

An Honest Note Before You Apply

I'll be upfront with you: I can be hard to work with. I have high standards, I move fast, and I'm direct in how I give feedback. If a post isn't right, I'll tell you straight — no sugar-coating. I'm not interested in mediocre work or excuses, and I expect the same energy back.

That said, I'm fair, I pay on time, I reward great work, and I genuinely look after the people who deliver for me. If you're someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes feedback well, and can handle direct communication without taking it personally — we'll work brilliantly together. If you need constant praise and a soft touch, this won't be the role for you.

Compensation & Trial

• $450 per month base pay.

• Performance bonus for every piece of content that hits 10K+ views.

• 1-week paid trial before we commit long-term. This is your chance to prove yourself, and mine to make sure we're the right fit.

• Clear scope to grow — both in pay and responsibility — as the brand grows and as you prove yourself.

How to Apply

Send the following to the
/inbox listed. The very first line of your application must answer this question:

"Do you have experience working with and building personal brands?"

Be honest. Give a clear yes or no, and back it up with examples. If your first line doesn't answer this question, I won't read the rest.

Then include:

• A short intro about yourself and why this role fits you.

• Your portfolio — graphic design samples and short-form video edits (links preferred).

• Any personal brands or social media accounts you've previously managed or grown (with results where possible).

• Your availability, time zone, and proposed daily check-in time.

Important — please read carefully:

To prove you've actually read this job description in full, please add the word "Ghana" somewhere in the subject line of your application
. Applications without this will not be reviewed. This is how I filter for people who pay attention to detail — a non-negotiable in this role.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Video Editor for AI UGC Meta Ads
description:
**Remote | Work from home**



We're a 6-figure DTC e-commerce brand running AI 
 ads on
 and Instagram. We need an editor who can take a script and turn it into a scroll-stopping ad — generating the AI UGC, voiceovers, and b-roll from scratch using our SOP and tools, then editing it all into a finished ad that converts.



---



## What You'll Be Doing



- Editing 60–120 second AI UGC ads for Meta (mainly 9:16)

- Working with AI avatar footage (Capcut, Higgsfield, Flow, ElevenLabs, etc.) and syncing it cleanly with AI voiceovers

- Layering b-roll, product shots, and supporting visuals

- Following our scripts and timing direction beat-by-beat

- Adding text overlays, captions, hooks, and CTAs

- Light sound design and music selection

- Delivering polished, on-brand ads with minimal revisions



## What You'll Receive From Us



- A finished script for every ad

- A detailed SOP walking you through our exact production process

- Brand guidelines and style references from our top-performing ads



You're handling the full production from script to final cut. We're handing you the system — your job is to execute it cleanly and consistently.



## What You Need



- Proven e-commerce / DTC ad editing experience (not vlogs, weddings, or music videos)

- Hands-on experience with AI UGC tools — (Capcut, Higgsfield, Flow, ElevenLabs, etc.)

- Comfortable generating AI avatars and voiceovers from scratch, not just editing pre-made footage

- Comfortable cleaning up AI avatar quirks (lip-sync drift, awkward pauses, robotic pacing) so the final product feels human

- Strong ability to follow a documented SOP without constant hand-holding

- Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve proficiency

- 24–48 hour turnaround, consistent quality



## Bonus Points



- Experience with ElevenLabs, Higgsfield, Flow, Kling, and other AI generation tools

- Ability to spot when an AI generation needs to be regenerated vs. salvaged

- A portfolio of e-commerce ads that have actually run (with results, if you have them)





---





## Expectations



1. **Send your resume with your application.** No resume = no reply.

2. **You must have DTC / e-commerce ad experience.** Not vlogs or music videos.

3. **You must have actually produced AI UGC ads before** — not just edited around AI footage someone else generated. Show us examples.

4. **You must complete a paid trial before hiring.** We send you a script, the SOP, and tool access. You produce one full ad end-to-end. Takes about 1–2 hours. Lets both of us see if it's a fit.





## Standards



Our ads compete against the best in DTC. If your AI UGC looks stiff, robotic, or sloppy — bad lip-sync, awkward cuts, dead pacing, or off-brand visuals — this isn't the role. If you can take a script and an SOP and produce ads that feel native to the feed and convert, you're exactly who we want.



## How to Apply



1. Resume with links to **AI UGC ads you've produced** (required — generic e-commerce ads aren't enough)

2. Which AI UGC tools you've worked with most

3. Timezone and weekly availability

4. If you've read this far, include the word "gunpowder" in the opening line of the message you send me containing your resume

5. One line on what makes your AI UGC ads convert





**No resume + no AI UGC portfolio = no interview.**

The brand runs regular live streams (card breaks, pack openings, customer interactions). Each stream contains 5-20 viral 
nts hidden inside hours of raw footage. We want editors who can scan footage efficiently, spot the gold (big reactions, surprise pulls, funny exchanges, emotional

nt

Study Twitch clip compilations on TikTok, podcast viral 
nts, and live event highlight reels. Look for editors who treat themselves as story scouts inside long-form footage.

nt viral (emotion, surprise, payoff)

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor — The Steadfast Athlete (YouTube)



About the Channel

The Steadfast Athlete is a YouTube channel about steadfast self-leadership through physical, mental, and spiritual discipline. The content is personal, documentary-style, faith-forward storytelling — not flashy fitness content or gym vlogs. Think more like a mini-documentary than an influencer video. The brand feel is dark, warm, earthy, and weathered — gritty and real, not polished or corporate.

I film on a smartphone and provide detailed edit blueprints for each video that lay out the story structure, music mood, pacing, and overall direction. I'm looking for an editor who can follow that direction while bringing their own creative instincts to the work. I want to see your interpretation of the blueprint, not a robotic execution of it.



What You'll Be Editing

1 long-form YouTube video every 2-4 weeks (8–30 minutes, documentary-style talking head + B-roll)

Optional: Short-form clips (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok) cut from the long-form video — this is an add-on, not required from day one



What I Provide You (via Google Drive)

Raw footage — talking head and personal B-roll I've filmed

A detailed edit blueprint for each video — story structure, section-by-section instructions, music mood map, and pacing guidance

A brand package — color palette, font information, and a full set of pre-made graphics (title cards, lower thirds, end cards) as PNG files



What I Need From You

Strong Adobe Premiere Pro skills — comfortable with Lumetri color grading, keyframing, audio mixing, J-cuts/L-cuts, speed ramping, and adjustment layers

An understanding of documentary-style pacing — knowing when to let a 
nt breathe vs. when to tighten the edit

Music selection — I provide mood direction and search terms in each blueprint. You find and select the right tracks. The brand standard for music is Artlist. For stock footage, the brand standard is Artgrid.

Audio mixing skills — dialogue cleanup, music balancing, room tone layering

Reliability and clear communication via



How B-Roll Works

I provide my own personal B-roll footage for each video. This should be your primary visual material — the authenticity of personal footage is important to this brand. Build the edit around what I give you.

If there's a 
nt where you feel additional stock footage would genuinely improve the video, you're expected to find it and include it. The brand standard for stock footage is Artgrid. If you need to use alternative sources, keep it consistent with the brand feel: dark, warm, earthy, authentic — not polished stock-photo energy.



How Music Works

Each edit blueprint includes a music mood map with the emotional direction for every section of the video — what it should feel like, when to build, when to drop to silence, and suggested search terms. You're responsible for finding and selecting the tracks. The brand standard for music is Artlist.



Bonus (Not Required)

Experience editing faith-based, personal development, or documentary content

Ability to cut YouTube Shorts, Reels, and TikToks from long-form footage

Thumbnail design skills

Color grading experience beyond basic Lumetri



Communication:

File sharing: Google Drive

Timezone: Flexible — I care about quality and deadlines, not when you're online



Compensation

$5-$7 USD/hour depending on how fast you can work with the quality of turnaround I am looking for. What I'm looking for is someone who sees this as a relationship we're building together. I take this work seriously, I'll provide thorough direction for every video, and I'm committed to making this a good working partnership for both of us. Michelle Khare on YouTube is an inspiration for me, and I want to make sure that my storytelling, pacing, and editing is as high-quality as hers as much as possible. Please only apply if you feel prepared to commit to that level of editing. I am trying to get time back on my calendar, but I want the editing to be at least as good or better than mine to grow on YouTube.



How to Apply

Send me:

A link to 2–3 videos you've edited that show your pacing and storytelling ability (YouTube links preferred)

A brief note about what kind of content you enjoy editing and why this role interests you

Your weekly availability



I'll send the top candidates a short test edit using real footage and an edit blueprint so I can see how you interpret direction while bringing your own creative instincts.

title: Front-End Developer — AI-Powered SaaS Platform
description:
Job Overview

We are a fast-growing SaaS company building an AI-powered business platform. We are multiple hiring front-end developers to join our engineering team under an experienced lead engineer. You will take finalized UI/UX designs from Figma and build them into a working, interactive product.



This is a build sprint. Our UI/UX team is producing screen designs now, and we want front-end developers ready to turn those designs into production-quality interfaces as they land. Each developer will own a specific section of the platform end to end — dashboards, CRM interfaces, content builders, AI-powered features, and similar. We'll match assignments based on your strengths and our priorities. You are not building generic pages — you are owning a product area.



Some of these roles may transition to long-term positions. Others are being brought on specifically to accelerate this phase. Either way, you will ship real product used by real customers.



What You Will Do

You will receive completed Figma designs from our UI/UX team and translate them into pixel-perfect, responsive, interactive screens. Our back-end team handles the data and logic — your job is making sure the user experience matches what was designed, performs well, and works across devices.



Core Skills (Required)

React and Next.js — this is the stack

Translating Figma designs into clean, responsive, pixel-perfect interfaces

API integration — GraphQL and REST

State management — Redux, Zustand, or Context API

Clear written English for daily team communication



Extra consideration for experience with Tailwind CSS, design systems, SaaS or dashboard interfaces, and accessibility optimization.



Schedule and Availability

Full-time, 40 hours per week. Our core team window is 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM PHT, Monday through Friday. Design and engineering work at the same time so questions get answered fast and handoffs stay clean. There will be weeks during the sprint where we may ask you to go beyond 40 hours — paid at your hourly rate.



Pay

Open to discussion based on experience.



How to Apply

Reply with a short message that includes:

1. Your name and location.

2. Years of front-end development experience.

3. Which of these are your strongest: React, Next.js, GraphQL, REST APIs, Redux/Zustand, CSS/responsive design? Pick your top 3 and tell us why.

4. Link to your portfolio, GitHub, or a live project you built — we want to see your work, not read about it.

5. Are you currently working with other companies? How many hours per week are you available?

6. Answer this: Pick any SaaS product you use regularly. Name one screen or flow in that product that frustrates you as a user, and describe how you would rebuild it. Be specific — we want to see how you think, not that you can write a paragraph.



Applications missing question 6 will not be reviewed.



Thanks

title: Full-Time Audio Engineer & Multimedia Editor
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Audio Engineer & Editor who understands how to create polished, professional audio and engaging multimedia content across multiple formats.



This is a long-term, full-time opportunity for someone who wants consistent work, enjoys creative problem solving, and takes pride in producing high-quality content.



Responsibilities



AUDIO ENGINEERING



You will be responsible for:



* Cleaning and mixing multitrack audio

* Creating separate mixes for:



  * YouTube/video versions

  * Audio-only podcast versions

  * Social media content

  * Commercial/client deliverables



* Removing: EACH TRACK NEEDS TO BE FULLY SCRUBBED - DO NOT JUST USE A NOISE GATE



  * Background noise

  * Mouth clicks

  * Heavy breaths

  * Reverb

  * Harsh sibilance

  * Pops and distractions

* Balancing levels between speakers

* Enhancing voice clarity and warmth

* Creating broadcast-quality final mixes



EDITING RESPONSIBILITIES



Projects may include:



* Podcasts

* Interviews

* Documentaries

* Social media reels

* Short-form content

* Commercial/business content

* YouTube content

* Promotional videos

* Branded content



You will:



* Edit multitrack conversations for pacing and engagement

* Remove awkward pauses, dead space, interruptions, and distractions

* Tighten conversations while maintaining natural flow

* Help identify strong 
nts and engaging content

* Follow editing guides and timestamp notes from our internal team

* Export final files in multiple formats and specifications



REQUIRED SKILLS



* Strong experience editing audio and multimedia content

* Experience working with multitrack/poly WAV files

* Advanced understanding of:



  * EQ

  * Compression

  * Noise reduction

  * Loudness standards

  * Dialogue cleanup

* Ability to create clean and natural sounding audio

* Strong storytelling and pacing instincts

* Experience using tools such as:



  * Adobe Audition

  * DaVinci Resolve Fairlight

  * Pro Tools

  * iZotope RX

  * Reaper

  * Adobe Premiere

  * DaVinci Resolve

  * or similar professional software

* Reliable internet and communication

* Ability to handle quick turnaround times

* Strong attention to detail



BONUS SKILLS



These are NOT required but are a major plus:



* Motion graphics

* Color grading

* Reel/short-form optimization

* Social media editing trends

* Understanding of YouTube pacing and retention

* Familiarity with AI-assisted workflows

* Experience with 
, Dropbox, 
, or approval systems



---



## What We’re Looking For



We are NOT looking for someone who just runs presets or basic cuts.



We are looking for someone who:



* understands storytelling,

* knows how to create engaging viewer/listener experiences,

* communicates professionally,

* can work independently,

* adapts to different types of projects,

* and takes pride in high-quality work.



You should be comfortable receiving feedback and adapting to different content styles and personalities.



---



## Paid Sample Project Required



Any candidate we seriously consider for this role will be required to complete a paid sample project before a final hiring decision is made.



This allows us to evaluate:



* audio quality,

* editing style,

* pacing,

* communication,

* turnaround time,

* and overall attention to detail.



---



## To Apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio or sample edits

2. Before/after audio examples if available

3. Your software/tools used

4. Your internet speed

5. Your availability and timezone

6. Why you believe you are a good fit for this role



Please include the phrase:

“Details matter.”

at the top of your application so we know you read the full posting.

title: AI Delivery Developer (Claude Code + Next.js + Supabase) — Part-time
description:
About the role:

I run a small AI agency called Qemoza. We build and run custom web platforms for our clients,
 tools, hiring platforms, dealer portals, research tools, paid media systems. I am hiring one developer to own routine delivery for our clients so I can focus more on growth.



This is a long-term role. We start part-time (20 hours a week) and your hours grow as you take on more clients. If you are looking for one stable client for the next 1+ year, this is it.



What you will do:

- Use AI tools (Claude Code Mainly) as your main way of writing code. Traditional coding is a plus, but AI fluency is the core skill

- Ship features for our client projects (Next.js, Supabase, sometimes n8n automations)

- Handle routine client delivery: weekly updates, daily DMs, Loom walkthroughs, simple bug fixes, small new features

- Join client calls with me occasionally (you are there to listen, take notes, follow up)



What I need from you:

- Shipped at least one full-stack web app to production (any stack, show me)

- Use AI dev tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) every day as your primary coding method, if not then having the ability to learn these tools

- Strong English, clear enough for communication

- Git experience branches, merge conflicts, deployments

- Have juggled 2+ project deadlines at the same time before

- You send updates and Loom videos without me asking

- Available 20 hours a week to start, with at least 4 hours of overlap per day with my time zone (Europe, France). afternoon and evening PH time works



What I do not need:

- Someone who needs daily video calls

- Someone who has never touched AI dev tools

- Someone who only works from a full spec doc (we move fast, you have to drive)



Pay:

- Month 1 (paid trial): 20 hours a week at $4 USD per hour (about $347 per month)

- Month 2 plus (if you pass the 30-day review): $5 USD per hour, with hours flexing between 20 and 40 per week depending on workload. So your monthly pay ranges from about $435 to $867 depending on what you ship that month

- Paid bi-weekly via Wise or PayPal, every 2 weeks

- Rate and cadence above are fixed for the first 90 days. No renegotiation in that window. If this does not work for you, please tell me NOW so we either agree on terms or part friendly



Tools I will give you on day 1:

- Claude Code account (I provide, $200 a month)

- GitHub access to our company org

- Vercel access per project

- Supabase access per project

- Slack for daily communication

- Access to our CRM for project tracking



How to apply:

Send me one message with all 3 of these:

1. Your GitHub link (or one project repo you can show) or showing the project inside of the video

2. A short Loom (3 minutes max) walking through your most recent project, what was hard, how you solved it, how AI helped

3. The phrase "Claude Code daily" at the top of your message so I know you read this



Messages without all 3 will be skipped. I am looking for one person for the long haul.



And more importantly, this is a role that you'll learn a lot of things in and you'll grow alongside the team

title: Back-End Developer — Core API & Application (TypeScript / Node.js)
description:
About the Role

We are a fast-growing SaaS company building an AI-powered business platform that brings CRM, content generation, lead generation, automation, and messaging into one connected system. We are hiring a back-end developer who is strong on REST APIs and business logic.



Our stack is TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Supabase, with integrations across AI services, payment processing, and other third-party platforms. When the team d
 on a new automation, a new capability, or a new way of handling user data, you are the developer who makes it real on the back end. You will design REST APIs, implement business logic, and ship features end to end.



You will also handle integration work as new third-party services come online — payment flows, AI model wiring, webhook handlers. You will work alongside our lead engineer and the rest of the back-end team. We are a small team that respects deep work, communicates honestly, and ships often. You will have real ownership of the features you build and the support of a team that has your back.



Core Skills (Required)

TypeScript and Node.js — this is the stack

REST API design and implementation

PostgreSQL — schema design, indexing, query fundamentals

Authentication patterns (OAuth, JWT)

Comfortable with third-party APIs and webhooks

Solid Git and code review habits

Clear written English for documentation and daily team communication



Extra consideration for experience with AI/LLM API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar), Supabase, payment integration (Stripe or similar), Next.js API routes, AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), and SaaS or multi-tenant architecture.



Schedule and Availability

Full-time, 40 hours per week. Our core team window is 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM PHT, Monday through Friday.



Pay

Open to discussion based on experience.



How to Apply

Reply with a short message that includes:

1. Your name and location.

2. Years of back-end development experience.

3. Your top 3–5 strongest technologies or platforms — be specific (Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Stripe, OpenAI API, etc.).

4. Link to your GitHub, portfolio, or any production work you can show — we want to see what you've built.

5. Are you currently working with other companies? How many hours per week are you available, and what is your timezone?

6. Answer this: Describe a feature you built end to end on the back end. What problem it solved, how you designed the API, and one tradeoff you had to make.

7. Answer this: Which interests you more — building a new feature from a clean spec, or untangling legacy code to make it work properly? Why?



Applications missing questions 6 and 7 will not be reviewed.

Top 3 Skills to Tag

Web Programming

Software Development Project Manager

Software QA Testing

Additional Skills

TypeScript / Node.js

REST API Design

PostgreSQL / Supabase

Third-Party API Integration

Authentication (OAuth / JWT)

title: Job Title: E-commerce Operations Controller (Freight, Inventory & Cost)
description:
PLEASE READ THIS JOB DESCRIPTION CAREFULLY



Who We Are



Southshore Fine Linens is a fast-growing home textiles brand operating 3,500+ SKUs across DTC, marketplaces, and wholesale channels, supported by a 68,000 sq ft distribution center and an in-house logistics operation.



We move a lot of product.

We spend a lot on freight.

We carry a lot of inventory.



We are looking for the person who can see where the money leaks — and close it.



The Mission of This Role



Your job is simple to describe and difficult to execute:



Treat our costs, freight, and inventory like a live control panel.



You will monitor, analyze, and optimize:



Shipping & carrier costs



3PL and warehouse expenses



Inventory levels and aging



SKU velocity and reorder timing



Storage fees and fulfillment fees



Landed cost per SKU



Cash tied up in inventory



Operational accuracy of our books vs reality



You are the person who asks every week:



“Why did this cost go up?”

“Why is this SKU still sitting?”

“Where are we leaking money?”



What You Will Own

???? Freight & Shipping Cost Control



Audit UPS, FedEx, LTL, and container freight invoices



Track cost per shipment, per SKU, per channel



Identify trends, billing errors, and optimization opportunities



Work with carriers to reduce rates and improve terms



Build weekly and monthly freight cost dashboards



???? Inventory Intelligence



Monitor inventory aging and turnover



Identify slow-moving and dead SKUs



Forecast reorder quantities based on velocity



Reduce over-ordering and stockouts



Track storage fees (FBA / warehouse) tied to poor inventory planning



???? Cost & Margin Visibility



Calculate true landed cost per SKU (product + freight + storage + handling)



Show margin after shipping and fulfillment costs



Highlight SKUs that look profitable but are not



Help leadership make smarter purchasing decisions



???? Books & Operational Reality



Reconcile operational data with QuickBooks / accounting reports



Ensure COGS, inventory value, and expenses reflect reality



Build clean reporting that ties operations to financials



???? Reporting & Dashboards



You will build and maintain:



Freight cost tracker



Inventory aging dashboard



SKU velocity report



Reorder model



Margin by SKU after logistics cost



Who You Are



You are not a traditional bookkeeper.



You are:



Extremely comfortable in Excel / Google Sheets



Naturally analytical and detail-obsessed



Experienced with inventory, logistics, or supply chain numbers



Someone who enjoys finding inefficiencies



Curious about why numbers change



Comfortable working with warehouse and logistics teams



The type of person who gets satisfaction from saving a company $5,000/month



Required Experience



3+ years in operations, inventory, logistics, or cost analysis



Strong spreadsheet skills (advanced formulas, pivots, modeling)



Experience analyzing freight / shipping / inventory data



Experience working with QuickBooks or similar accounting software



Experience in e-commerce, retail, or product-based business preferred



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)



Clear visibility into all freight and shipping costs



Identified cost leaks and implemented savings



Clean inventory aging and velocity reports



Reorder model in place



Leadership can see true margin per SKU



Why This Role Matters



This is a high-impact role.

The right person in this seat will pay for themselves many times over by reducing costs and improving inventory decisions.



How to Apply



Send your resume and a short note explaining a time you found a cost inefficiency and how you fixed it.



Work hours:

MONDAY THRU FRIDAY - Pacific Standard Time.

title: Build Searchable Lecture Archive — Python Developer with AI/Search Experience
description:
Job Title: Build Searchable Lecture Archive — Python Developer with AI/Search Experience

To confirm you read this posting, please start your reply with the word "Miller."

About the Project

We are Simchas Hachaim Publishing (a division of Yeshiva Gedolah Bais Yisroel), and we have an archive of approximately 2,000 lectures by Rabbi Avigdor Miller. The lectures have been transcribed into Word documents (.docx) and are stored in a Dropbox folder. We need a developer to build a search engine that lets our internal staff search the full archive by topic and keyword.

Please note: this is religious Jewish material (Torah lectures). Applicants should be comfortable working with this subject matter.

What Needs to Be Built

A working search engine over ~2,000 .docx transcripts with the following requirements:

Core functionality:



Semantic/topic search — e.g., "everywhere Rabbi Miller discussed bitachon during financial hardship" — using AI embeddings so search works even where transcripts have errors

Exact keyword search — for finding specific words or phrases

Results show snippets with context plus the source lecture number and a link to open the original .docx

Filter by lecture number or date if metadata is available



Important requirements:



The system must work on the current imperfect transcripts (some Hebrew, Yiddish, and Aramaic terms are mangled). Later, a scholar will go through and correct the transcripts, and the search engine must automatically re-index updated files (drop-in folder model — no manual import each time).

Fully automated ingestion — when a transcript is updated or a new one added to the folder, the system picks it up without manual work.

Data ownership — all transcripts and the search index must remain in formats we own and can export. No platform lock-in.

Internal use first — for SHP staff. Public-facing access may come later, so build with that in mind but don't over-engineer for it now.

Future audio linking — eventually we want search results to link to the original audio recording of that lecture. Not required in v1, but please structure the data so this can be added later.



Technical preferences (open to your recommendations):



Python-based

A vector database (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, or similar) for semantic search

A simple web interface (Flask, FastAPI, or Streamlit is fine) — does not need to be fancy, just functional

Should run either on a local server or affordable cloud hosting; please advise on the cheapest sustainable hosting option



Deliverables



Working Python script(s) that ingest all .docx files from a Dropbox folder, parse them, and build/update the search index automatically

A simple web interface staff can use to search and view results

Clear written documentation: how to run it, how to update it, how to add new transcripts

A 30-minute video walkthrough of the system at the end of the project

All source code delivered to us (GitHub repo or zipped files)



What I Need From You in Your Application



Examples of similar work — search engines, document indexing, RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) systems, or similar projects you've built

Your proposed approach — briefly, which tools/stack would you recommend and why

Estimated timeline to a working v1

Your availability — hours per week and overlap with U.S. Eastern Time

Experience with AI/LLM tools — OpenAI API, Anthropic API, embeddings, vector databases



Nice to Have



Experience with Hebrew/Yiddish/Aramaic text processing

Experience building tools for religious or academic archives

Familiarity with Dropbox API

Manage paid job board budgets and report on cost-per-hire weekly

2. Pre-screen and interview

Conduct first-round interviews (30 min) using our structured rubrics

Score candidates against our standardized scorecards — no gut calls

Pass top candidates to hiring managers with a written summary, scorecard, and recommendation

Conduct reference checks before any candidate advances to a final round

3. Follow our process exactly, then improve it

You will use our AI bot daily to look up rubrics, interview guides, role requirements, and policy

After 60 days, you'll have earned the right to suggest improvements — backed by data, not opinion

We update our process every month based on what's working. You'll be part of that

4. Own the candidate experience



Every applicant gets a response within 5 business days — no exceptions

Rejected candidates get a polite, branded "no thanks" with the door left open

Top candidates get fast, clear communication through every stage

We measure candidate NPS. You're responsible for it.

5. Report weekly to the Operations Manager



Funnel volume by source

Conversion rates at every stage

Cost-per-hire by role

Time-to-fill by role

Pipeline gaps and what you're doing about them

Who You AreBackground (non-negotiable)



5+ years of recruiting experience, at least 2 of which were at high volume (40+ hires/year)

You've worked at a remote-first company for at least 2 years

You've recruited for roles in BPO, customer service, sales, or operations — this matters because our roles look like those

You speak and write fluent, professional English. You will be writing constantly to North American candidates

Skills (non-negotiable)



You are an expert at LinkedIn Recruiter cold outreach. You can show us your message templates, your reply rates, and your booking rates. If you can't, you're not the right fit

You've built Boolean searches from scratch — you don't copy them off the internet

You've used at least one ATS (Bamboo, Greenhouse, Workable, Lever, or similar). We use HubSpot for tracking — you'll learn it fast

You use AI tools daily in your work today. Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent. You can describe how

You're comfortable with high volume — 400+ applications/week doesn't scare you

You've done reference checks regularly and know what questions to ask

Personality (non-negotiable)



You follow process before improving it. If you read this and thought "but I'd do it my own way," you're not the right fit. We have a system. You learn the system first

Detail-obsessed — you don't miss steps, you don't skip rubrics, you don't make gut calls

Direct communicator — you can tell a hiring manager "this candidate isn't a fit" and back it up

Low drama — when challenged, you respond with data, not feelings

High pace — we move fast and expect you to keep up

Curious about systems and tools — you read manuals when handed them

What This Job Is Not



So you can self-select honestly:



This is not an HR generalist role. No payroll, no policy work, no benefits administration. Pure recruiting

This is not a coordinator role. You're not scheduling interviews and processing paperwork. You're sourcing, screening, and selecting

This is not a "do it your way" role. We have a documented system. You follow it. After 60 days, you earn the right to improve it

This is not a low-volume role. If you've only ever filled 10–15 roles per year, this will overwhelm you

This is not a slow company. We move fast, we measure everything, and we expect the same of you

If after reading this you're thinking "this is the role I've been looking for," please apply. If you're thinking "I could probably do most of this," please don't.



Compensation & Logistics



Salary: See top of post. Based on experience and market

title: Talking Head Editor for Trading Card Brand Founder Content (Long-Term)
description:
POLISH THE FOUNDER'S CAMERA TIME



I am hiring a part-time TikTok editor for a fast-growing Trading Card Game (TCG) content brand. This post is for editors who specialize in talking-head and founder content.



The brand's founder appears on camera regularly to explain the business model, share insights, answer questions, and build trust with viewers. We want editors who can take raw camera footage and turn it into clean, fast-paced, retention-optimized shorts. Cut filler words, add captions, layer B-roll, sync audio cleanly. Make the founder look as sharp on TikTok as they sound in person.



WHAT YOU WILL EDIT



- 5-8 talking-head videos per day, Monday to Friday

- 30-60 second edits from raw founder camera footage

- Tight cuts removing filler words ("um," "uh," dead air, restarts)

- Add captions, B-roll cutaways, supporting graphics where needed

- Emphasize hook in first 3 seconds, retention beats throughout

- Output 9:16 vertical, deliver via Drive



STYLE REFERENCE



Study founder content from creators like Alex Hormozi, Codie Sanchez, Steven Bartlett (short clips). Look for editors who can take long-form raw footage and produce tight, high-retention shorts. 
 
 for our brand reference. These are reference accounts only, not the brand you will be editing for.



REQUIREMENTS



- 6+ months short-form video editing experience

- Portfolio with talking-head, podcast clip, or founder content editing

- Strong filler-word cutting skill (clean jump cuts without obvious gaps)

- Caption styling and timing proficiency

- Comfortable matching B-roll to spoken audio

- Proficient in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

- Available Mon-Fri, 5 days/week, around 1.5 to 2 hours/day

- Filipino editors preferred for timezone alignment



BONUS POINTS



- Past work editing podcast clips or business creator content

- Familiar with AI-powered tools (Descript, AutoCut, Opus Clip) for transcription

- Experience with retention-driven editing for talking heads

- Understanding of hook-first structures for founder content



COMPENSATION



PHP 16,800/month (paid weekly at PHP 4,200 every Friday). 5-8 talking-head videos/day x 5 days = 25-40 videos/week. Lower daily volume because raw camera footage requires more cleanup work. Performance bonuses after 60 days.



HOW TO APPLY



In your application include:

1. 2-3 portfolio links showing your best talking-head or podcast clip editing

2. Your usual turnaround time for one 30-60 second talking-head edit from raw camera footage

3. Confirm you can commit to 5-8 talking-head videos/day, Mon-Fri

4. Pick any past talking-head edit and explain WHY you made the specific cuts you did (2-3 sentences)



Applications missing the cut explanation will not be reviewed.



SELECTION PROCESS



1. Review application within 48 hours

2. Short message exchange with shortlisted candidates

3. Final hire within 1 week

4. First week serves as paid trial. Meeting standards = continue. If not = part ways professionally, keep trial payment



Long-term role, minimum 3-month commitment expected.

title: SEO / AEO / GEO Specialist — Multi-Client Website Optimization
description:
We are looking for an experienced SEO / AEO / GEO specialist who can handle execution and light strategy across multiple client websites.



This role is not just blog writing or basic SEO tasks. You will be responsible for building, structuring, optimizing, and improving client websites so they can perform better in Google Search, local search, Google Business Profile, and AI-driven search experiences like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, and other answer engines.



You should be comfortable managing up to 7 client accounts at a time while maintaining quality, organization, and consistency.



We will provide direction, strategy, and content support when needed, but you should be able to work independently, identify gaps, make judgment calls, and execute without needing constant hand-holding.



Responsibilities include:



- Building and optimizing service pages and location pages from scratch

- Structuring pages for SEO, AEO, and GEO visibility

- Improving content so it answers real customer questions clearly

- Optimizing headers, page layout, metadata, internal linking, and page hierarchy

- Creating or improving FAQ sections and answer-first content blocks

- Helping organize topical content clusters and supporting blog content

- Implementing content directly in WordPress and other CMS platforms

- Supporting Google Business Profile optimization when needed

- Identifying missing content, weak pages, local SEO gaps, and conversion issues

- Recommending schema opportunities such as Organization, LocalBusiness, Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, Article, and other relevant markup

- Tracking and reporting improvements across SEO, local visibility, and AI visibility

- Managing multiple client websites while keeping work organized and consistent



You should be comfortable with:



- Managing up to 7 clients at a time

- Working across different industries

- Building service and location pages

- Working inside WordPress, Elementor, and common SEO plugins

- Making practical decisions when direction is incomplete

- Understanding search intent, local intent, and conversational AI search behavior

- Writing or editing content for clarity, structure, and conversion

- Following SOPs while still thinking independently

- Communicating progress clearly



Ideal candidate:



- 3+ years of SEO experience

- Strong local SEO experience preferred

- Experience building service pages and location pages

- Comfortable with WordPress or similar CMS platforms

- Understands AEO / GEO concepts or is already applying them

- Familiar with Google Search Console, GA4, GBP, Ahrefs, Semrush, SurferSEO, Rank Math, Yoast, or similar tools

- Strong attention to detail

- Fast with execution

- Able to manage multiple client websites without quality dropping



Important:



We are not looking for a beginner or someone who only writes blog posts.



This is an execution-focused role with real responsibility. The right person should understand how to improve a website for traditional SEO, local SEO, and AI-driven search visibility.



You do not need to be a perfect AEO expert, but you do need to understand how content structure, entity clarity, FAQs, internal linking, schema, trust signals, and local relevance help a business become easier for AI systems and search engines to understand, cite, and recommend.



To apply, please include:



1. Your resume

2. Examples of service pages or location pages you worked on

3. Examples of local SEO or Google Business Profile work, if available

4. A short answer to this question:



Pick one local business website you worked on or know well. What would you change to make it more likely to appear in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, or other AI-driven search results? Please mention content structure, prompts, trust signals, schema, and how you would measure improvement.
