title: Luxury Event Concierge Specialist
description:
We are a luxury event-planning company based in Los Angeles, specializing in premium picnics, proposals, birthdays, baby showers, bridal showers, tablescapes, and private celebrations.



We are looking for a reliable, polished, and highly detail-oriented Luxury Event Concierge Specialist to support client communication, lead follow-ups, reservations, payments, and event coordination.



This is a client-facing luxury concierge role, not a basic Virtual Assistant position. We need someone who can communicate professionally with US clients, guide leads through the booking process, handle pricing conversations, notice missing details, and take ownership without repeated reminders.



The right person is calm, organized, proactive, and comfortable helping clients move from first inquiry to confirmed booking.



This role starts at 20 hours/week, with the opportunity to grow into 30–40 hours/week for the right person.



Work Hours



Our main business hours are 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM PT / California time.



The exact schedule will be discussed during the hiring process, but we are looking for someone who can commit to a consistent part-time schedule of approximately 4 hours per day, 5 days per week.



What This Role Really Means



You will help protect the client experience from inquiry to event day.



You will be responsible for making sure leads are followed up with, clients receive clear answers, reservations are organized, payments are tracked, and missing details are noticed before they become problems.



This role requires someone who can think ahead, communicate clearly, and help keep the business organized every day.



Responsibilities

- Respond to client inquiries by
, phone, text, and messages

- Handle client calls professionally and confidently

- Follow up with leads and help convert inquiries into bookings

- Guide clients through packages, pricing, availability, and booking steps

- Handle pricing questions and objections in a polished, professional way

- Add new reservations and update client records

- Track payments, balances, event details, and client notes

- Review upcoming events for missing details, timing issues, or unclear requests

- Prepare client messages, summaries, and internal updates

- Support event planners with organized reservation information

- Help create and update event checklists when needed

- Use tools such as Gmail, Google Sheets, Asana, Stripe, and ChatGPT

- Escalate urgent or unclear situations before they become problems

- Help maintain a luxury-level client experience from inquiry to event day



Must-Have Requirements

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Confident speaking with US clients by phone

- Experience in customer success, sales, hospitality, events, weddings, travel, concierge service, or premium customer service

- Strong follow-up skills and comfort helping turn inquiries into bookings

- Ability to handle pricing questions professionally

- Very strong attention to detail with dates, times, payments, client requests, and event notes

- Reliable, proactive, and able to complete work without repeated reminders

- Comfortable with spreadsheets, admin work, and structured processes

- Fast internet, quiet workspace, and professional communication style

- Backup plan for internet or power issues, such as hotspot, mobile access, or another reliable work location

- Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT to improve drafts, summaries, and templates



Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate has experience supporting premium clients and understands that tone, timing, accuracy, and follow-up matter.



You may be a strong fit if you:

-Can write polished and natural client messages

- Are comfortable with both sales follow-up and client support

- Can organize details without constant supervision

- Notice missing information before it creates a problem

- Know when to answer directly and when to escalate

- Stay calm and professional under pressure

- Want a long-term role with growth potential



Please Do Not Apply If

- You are looking for a basic VA/admin role only

- You are not comfortable speaking with clients by phone

- You need repeated reminders to complete tasks

- You are not detail-oriented with dates, times, payments, and client requests

- You are uncomfortable with sales follow-ups or pricing conversations

- You prefer step-by-step instructions for every small task

- You do not have reliable internet or a backup plan for remote work issues



Compensation

Starting at $6–$9/hour, depending on experience, phone confidence, sales ability, and relevant background.



This role starts at 20 hours/week, with potential to grow into 30–40 hours/week for the right person.



Performance bonuses and pay increases may be available after the probation period based on reliability, client communication, lead follow-up, booking support, attention to detail, and overall ownership.



We are looking for someone who can prove strong communication, judgment, reliability, and attention to detail before moving into a long-term role.



To Apply



Please answer all questions below. Applications without complete answers will not be reviewed.



1. What experience do you have with luxury clients, events, hospitality, weddings, travel, concierge service, sales, or premium customer service?

2. Describe a time when you helped close a client, saved a client relationship, or handled a difficult customer professionally.

3. Have you handled phone calls with US clients? Please describe the type of calls and your comfort level.

4. A client says: “Your picnic is too expensive. Other companies are cheaper.” Write your professional reply.

5. A client asks for a proposal picnic quote but does not respond after receiving pricing. Write your follow-up message.

6. You are reviewing tomorrow’s events and notice that one client has not paid the remaining balance and the final location is not confirmed. What would you do?

7. Your power or internet goes out during your shift. What is your backup plan and how would you notify the team?

8. Are you available during 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM California time? Please share your preferred schedule and confirm if you are open to Tuesday–Saturday availability.

9. In the first line of your application, write: “I understand this is a client-facing luxury event concierge role.”



Please attach your most recent resume/CV. Thank you.

title: GoHighLevel Expert + Social Media Manager
description:
About Rayanova

Rayanova is a digital growth agency helping hospitality businesses in Mexico build their online presence. We build automated systems that drive real revenue: review generation, booking automation, customer follow-up, reputation management, and conversion-focused websites.

We're growing fast. We need someone who can come in and own the GHL side of the business, setting up clients, building the systems, and helping us scale.



The Role

We're looking for a GoHighLevel Expert who can take full ownership of how we onboard and set up clients inside GHL. You'll be building the workflows, funnels, automations, voice agents, and chatbots that power our clients' businesses, and you'll help us build the systems and templates that make onboarding new clients fast and repeatable.

This is a real, long-term role. You'll work directly with the founder and have genuine ownership over what you build.

Social media management is a bonus, not the focus. If you can help with scheduling and content management inside GHL, great. But what we really need is someone who is exceptional at GHL operations and automation.



What You'll Own

Client Onboarding and Sub-Account Setup

You'll build out new client sub-accounts from scratch inside GHL, including pipelines, stages, custom fields, tags, calendars, forms, and products. You'll create and manage snapshots so we can onboard future clients faster, and you'll build the internal checklists and systems that make our onboarding process repeatable as we scale.

Workflows and Automations

You'll build end-to-end automated workflows covering lead follow-up, booking confirmations, appointment reminders, review requests, re-engagement campaigns, and no-show handling. This includes SMS,
, and WhatsApp sequences, as well as connecting GHL to external tools using 
, Zapier, or webhooks. You'll also monitor and troubleshoot running automations to keep everything working.

Voice Agents and Chatbots

You'll build and configure voice agents for inbound and outbound calling inside GHL, and set up chatbots for website chat, Instagram DMs,
 Messenger, and WhatsApp. You'll write the conversation scripts and set up the handoff logic so contacts reach the right person at the right time.

Reputation and CRM Management

You'll set up and manage automated review request campaigns via SMS,
, and WhatsApp, maintain contact databases, pipelines, tags, and lead organization, and build landing pages, booking pages, and simple funnels inside GHL.

Social Media (Bonus)

If you have experience here, you'll use GHL's social planner to schedule and manage posts across Instagram,
, and TikTok, monitor engagement, respond to comments and DMs, and pull basic performance reports for clients.



What We Need

You have 2 or more years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience, not just basic use. You've set up GHL sub-accounts for clients from scratch, built complex workflows and automation sequences, set up voice agents and chatbots inside GHL, and created snapshots and reusable templates. You write strong English for customer-facing messages and team communication. You can work independently, manage your own tasks, and communicate clearly. You're available full-time (40 hours per week) with some overlap during US and Mexico time zones.



Bonus Points

Experience with 
 for multi-step automations, GHL certification or active involvement in the GHL community, familiarity with Twilio, LC Phone, or LC
 setup, experience building websites and landing pages inside GHL or on platforms like WordPress or Webflow, experience with hospitality or restaurant brands, Spanish language skills, and basic Canva or CapCut skills.



What We Offer

$600 to $850 per month USD based on experience. Fully remote, work from anywhere in the Philippines. Full-time, stable, long-term role, not a short project. Direct access to the founders with no layers of management. A role where your work actually matters and you can see the results. As we grow and take on more clients, your role and compensation grow with us. All GHL tools and software access provided.

 accounts (show us your work)

title: Scalable Next.js Commerce Upgrade
description:
I’m moving the production e-commerce platform from a brittle monolith to a fully-type-safe stack based on Next.js v14, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Auth.js, and Stripe. The immediate, highest-priority task is a thorough refactor of the existing legacy codebase so we can eliminate the high server response times that are slowing checkout and catalogue pages.  



Once the worst bottlenecks are gone, the roadmap continues with clean REST/GraphQL APIs and a hardened Stripe integration, all built with TDD and modern best practices in mind. You’ll be working inside a GitHub repo with CI already wired for Jest and ESLint; every merge must keep tests green and Lighthouse scores healthy.



Key context you should know:

• Current pain point: performance inefficiencies, specifically high server response times.  

• Tech already in place: Next.js 14 on the front end, NestJS services layer, PostgreSQL 15, Auth.js for sessions, Stripe for payments.  

• Priority order: 1) Refactor legacy code, 2) Build clean APIs, 3) Finalise secure payments.



Deliverables (acceptance criteria):

1. Refactored modules pass existing unit tests plus any you add, with p95 API response < 200 ms under 500 concurrent users (k6 script provided).  

2. New or updated endpoints documented via OpenAPI and verified with Postman collection.  

3. Stripe checkout flow completed end-to-end in test mode, with webhook handling and graceful failure paths.  

4. Pull-request walkthrough recorded (loom or similar) so my in-house team can follow architectural decisions.



If you’ve shipped something similar—ideally with Next.js + NestJS—and can point to benchmarks or repo snippets, that will help me shortlist quickly. Feel free to DM links to live demos, PRs, or case studies.

mbers

mber who understands the current workflow

title: Customer Account Manager
description:
**Full Time | Philippines | Night Shift / U.S. Eastern Hours**



**About Promofect**

Promofect is a U.S.-based promotional products and custom apparel company serving corporate teams, schools, first responders, and small businesses. We handle everything from branded merchandise and decorated apparel to fully managed online company stores — and we do much of our own production in-house. We're a tight-knit, fast-moving team that takes pride in doing great work for our customers. We're also a team that embraces AI tools and technology to work smarter. If you're curious about AI and actively looking for ways to use it in your work, you'll fit right in here.



**The Role**

We're looking for an experienced customer-facing professional to join our Philippines team. You'll manage customer accounts, handle inbound calls and
s, prepare quotes, and support our online merch stores. Beyond the day-to-day, we want someone who proactively follows up with customers, brings fresh ideas to grow accounts, improves how we work, and collaborates closely with our sales and marketing teams.



**Key Responsibilities**

- Manage customer accounts from first inquiry through order completion

- Answer inbound calls and
s from U.S. customers during business hours

- Prepare quotes and proposals for promotional products and custom apparel

- Proactively follow up with existing customers — check in, identify new needs, and help grow accounts

- Support customers on our online merch stores (order questions, tracking, sizing, account issues)

- Identify ways to improve processes and workflows across the customer experience

- Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to align on accounts, campaigns, and opportunities

- Maintain accurate records across Printavo, HubSpot, and related systems



**Requirements**

- 5+ years in customer service, account management, or sales support

- Strong spoken and written English — you will be on the phone with U.S. customers daily

- Experience with order management software (we use Printavo)

- Familiarity with online merch store platforms such as InkSoft, Chipply, or Shopify

- Proactive, organized, and able to manage multiple accounts without dropping the ball

- Someone who looks for better ways to do things — not just someone who executes tasks

- Comfortable with AI tools and genuinely curious about how they can improve your work

- Reliable internet and professional work-from-home setup

- Available full-time during U.S. Eastern business hours



**Big Plus If You Have Experience With**

- Promotional products, custom apparel, screen printing, or embroidery

- HubSpot or similar CRM platforms

- Supporting or mentoring other tea
mbers



**Growth Opportunity**

We're a growing company and we invest in people who show up and perform. Strong performers will have real opportunities to take on more responsibility as the business grows.



**To Apply, Please Send:**

1. Your resume

2. A short video intro — tell us about yourself and why you're a great fit for this role

3. Examples of customer service or account management experience

4. Your internet speed and computer setup

5. Expected monthly salary

6. How you are currently using AI in your work — tools you use, how you use them, and your honest thoughts on where AI is headed. There's no wrong answer, but we do want to see that you're thinking about it.
